ns2:section.sectionTitle: MEP Road Map to Grad School
ns2:section.sectionText: MEP Mentoring: Road Map to Grad School. This course will introduce undergraduate students to advanced degrees and how to best prepare for the application process. The course will provide opportunities to explore graduate programs, develop application materials, and understanding funding mechanisms. Intended for juniors and advanced sophomores.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering. Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
